scope: Independent source and assertion review of session renewal and remaining release evidence.

unit_result.execution_limit: JSDOM and existing mocks. ForceExit handles existing open handles.

resolved_findings.prior_fact: The explicit-failure fixture used a fixed token expiry without freezing the test clock.
resolved_findings.consequence: An expired header could hide a regression in body-failure rejection.
resolved_findings.resolution: Freeze Date.now per case. Add a valid-success authorization control.
resolved_findings.next_action: Retain the committed correction and matching unit evidence.

findings.title: Production applicability lacks deployment binding
facts: Stage readiness excludes production approval without deployed evidence.
The local fixture disables module federation remotes and uses synthetic identity and authorization adapters.
findings.consequence: Local assertions cannot establish production provider, gateway, embedded application, or toolkit behavior.
findings.next_action: Bind deployed revisions and settings. Execute the mapped cases against a representative environment.
findings.scope_limit: This limits production confidence. It does not invalidate passing local predicates.

findings.title: Shared-origin portal tab interactions remain untested
facts: The routing storage listener updates theme only.
Each portal maintains authentication in its React reducer.
Access persistence writes local storage and session storage.
The natural background control uses a separate browser context.
inferences: Concurrent portal tabs could retain stale authentication after logout or credential rotation.
findings.consequence: A second tab could show inconsistent session state or write retained credentials into shared storage.
findings.next_action: Confirm the tab interaction policy. Test concurrent renewal, logout, and reload in one browser context.
findings.scope_limit: No failure was reproduced. Existing acceptance criteria do not define global tab logout behavior.

findings.title: Embedded API traffic can request renewal outside Home activity checks
facts: Cashflow fulfilled queries invoke the shared extension export.
Ratan GraphQL invokes the export after query completion.
The shared helper checks credentials and logout state without checking document visibility.
The current fixture disables module federation remotes.
inferences: Background application traffic could change idle-session observations.
findings.consequence: Portal-only idle controls cannot establish behavior with representative application queries.
findings.next_action: Confirm eligible activity. Test visible-idle and hidden sessions with representative application traffic.
findings.scope_limit: Consumer revisions remain unknown. This source path does not establish a deployed defect.

findings.title: Protected operation covers portal validation only
facts: The example protected operation calls the portal authentication validation endpoint.
The retained fixture excludes a trading workflow.
findings.consequence: Renewed portal access does not establish downstream business authorization or business-query success.
findings.next_action: Configure one inspected read-only application operation. Assert its response and renewed request credential.
findings.scope_limit: The existing portal validation predicate remains useful within its stated boundary.

findings.title: Provider refusal and revocation have no matching fixture
facts: The manual retry case aborts the first transport request.
The credential denial case waits for natural access expiry.
The local fixture substitutes identity and authorization adapters.
findings.consequence: Transport retry and natural expiry results cannot establish provider refusal or revocation behavior.
findings.next_action: Obtain an authorized provider fixture. Assert the agreed refusal, revocation, and recovery outcomes.
findings.scope_limit: No provider defect or global revocation behavior is claimed.

findings.title: Absent-credential recovery and application-edit restoration remain unresolved
facts: TC-04 records O-001 without an expected recovery outcome.
TC-07 records O-004 and compares workspace descriptors.
The default workspace fixture creates empty workspaces.
findings.consequence: Observation success cannot establish recovery acceptance or preservation of application edits.
findings.next_action: Resolve O-001 and O-004. Define expected outcomes and supply populated application fixtures.
findings.scope_limit: Descriptor equality does not establish application memory, entitlement, or cross-origin content restoration.

findings.title: Click and touch activity require a defined policy
facts: Home binds mouse movement, keyboard input, and captured scroll activity.
Requirement version 4 names those activity types.
Cross-origin embedded activity requires separate integration evidence.
inferences: Click-only and touch-only use could follow different renewal paths.
findings.consequence: The current inventory cannot establish eligibility for activity outside the defined event scope.
findings.next_action: Confirm supported input types before adding acceptance cases or changing event bindings.
findings.scope_limit: These inputs are scope questions. They are not demonstrated violations of version 4.

findings.title: Manual renewal stops before nominal refresh expiry
facts: The timeout controller schedules logout two seconds before refresh expiry.
inferences: A slow pending renewal near that boundary could be cancelled before nominal credential expiry.
findings.consequence: The final renewal window depends on an inherited early-logout policy.
findings.next_action: Confirm the two-second lead policy. Retain boundary assertions before changing that behavior.
findings.scope_limit: The behavior predates this test correction. No new application defect is claimed.

findings.title: Changed extension request guard fails the declared typecheck
facts: The current typecheck fails with four diagnostics.
Two TS18048 diagnostics identify changed extension request guard lines.
Two Home test diagnostics recur on baseline source with current dependencies.
The proposed guard removes both changed application diagnostics in an isolated copy.
The proposal still fails with the two reproduced baseline diagnostics.
inferences: The explicit existence guard preserves runtime request-sharing behavior.
findings.consequence: The selected revision lacks a passing declared typecheck. Browser success cannot establish production build success.
findings.next_action: Review the narrow proposed patch. Assign the baseline test diagnostics. Repeat typecheck and a configured production build.
findings.scope_limit: The proposal remains unapplied. Full production build lacks environment and Storybook configuration.
